camel_example: aliyun cloudfw UpdateApplicationCustomRules --region cn-hangzhou --Rules '[{"RemoveApplicationIds":[10012150000],"Priority":2,"AddApplicationIds":[10012150000],"ApplicationCustomRuleName":"自定义规则02","RuleAction":"Alert","ApplicationCustomRuleId":"acr-7d2e4f6a8b0c1d3e"}]'
description_en: Modifies custom application rules in batches. You can modify up to 20 rules at a time. The template to which a rule belongs is queried based on the rule ID, so you do not need to specify the template ID
description_zh: 批量修改应用程序自定义规则。单次最多修改20条规则。规则所属模板由规则ID反查，无需传入模板ID
kebab_example: aliyun cloudfw update-application-custom-rules --rules '[{"RemoveApplicationIds":[10012150000],"Priority":2,"AddApplicationIds":[10012150000],"ApplicationCustomRuleName":"自定义规则02","RuleAction":"Alert","ApplicationCustomRuleId":"acr-7d2e4f6a8b0c1d3e"}]' --api-version 2017-12-07 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateApplicationCustomRules

fields.help_en: The list of application IDs to be associated. You can specify up to 200 IDs. The IDs cannot be 0 and must exist in the built-in application signature library. The IDs must not overlap with those in RemoveApplicationIds. The combined list cannot be empty and can contain up to 200 IDs
fields.help_zh: 要新增关联的应用程序ID列表。最多200个，ID不能为0且必须为内置应用特征库中已存在的应用；不得与RemoveApplicationIds重复，合并后列表不能为空且不超过200个
fields.name: add_application_ids

fields.help_en: The ID of the custom application rule to be modified. The rule must exist within the current Alibaba Cloud account
fields.help_zh: 要修改的应用程序自定义规则ID。必须为当前阿里云账号下已存在的规则
fields.name: application_custom_rule_id

fields.help_en: The name of the custom rule. The name can be up to 64 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, hyphens (-), underscores (_), and periods (.). If this parameter is not specified or is left empty, the original value is retained
fields.help_zh: 自定义规则名称。长度不超过64个字符，支持中文、英文字母、数字、短划线（-）、下划线（_）和半角句号（.）。不传或传空时保持原值
fields.name: application_custom_rule_name

fields.help_en: The priority of the rule. This parameter is required. Valid values: integers from 1 to 200. A smaller value indicates a higher priority. Priorities must be unique within the same template. You can swap priorities by deleting and then re-inserting rules
fields.help_zh: 规则优先级，实际必填。取值范围为1~200的整数，数值越小优先级越高。同一模板内优先级不可重复；支持通过先删后插实现优先级互换
fields.name: priority

fields.help_en: The list of application IDs to be disassociated. You can specify up to 200 IDs. The IDs must not overlap with those in AddApplicationIds. The combined list cannot be empty and can contain up to 200 IDs
fields.help_zh: 要移除关联的应用程序ID列表。最多200个；不得与AddApplicationIds重复，合并后列表不能为空且不超过200个
fields.name: remove_application_ids

fields.help_en:
The action to perform when the rule is matched. This parameter is required. Valid values:
Allow: allows the traffic.
Alert: monitors the traffic.
Deny: blocks the traffic
fields.help_zh:
规则命中后执行的动作，实际必填。取值：
Allow：放行。
Alert：观察。
Deny：拦截
fields.name: rule_action

parameters.help_en: The list of custom application rules to be modified. You can specify up to 20 rules at a time. Rule IDs in the list must be unique
parameters.help_zh: 待修改的应用程序自定义规则列表。单次最多传入20条规则，列表内规则ID不可重复
parameters.name: rules
